consequence.statement: Ingested logs get an automatically assigned service_name label (or unknown_service if no listed label matches) unless a service_label already exists or discover_service_name is set to empty.
consequence.remediation: Set discover_service_name to an empty value in limits_config to disable, or customize the label list.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0 now automatically assigns a service_name label to all ingested logs by default, discovered from a list of labels configurable via limits_config.discover_service_name (empty value disables it).

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for config-key behavior-changed
